origin.description: Run code and then repeat the same draws, because the seed was restored.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run without advancing the caller's seed.

origin.details: The two blocks of four uniforms match. They are R's runif after set.seed(1).
origin.example:
set.seed(1)
a <- with_preserve_seed(runif(4))
b <- runif(4)
c(a, b)

translation.description: Run code and then repeat the same draws, because the seed was restored.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run without advancing the caller's seed.

translation.details: The two blocks of four uniforms match. They are R's runif after set.seed(1). code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

from withr._rng import set_seed
set_seed(1)
a = with_preserve_seed(lambda: runif(4))
b = runif(4)
return a + b
